source.pagination: The API reported total_count=110; pagination returned 100 records on page 1 and 10 on page 2; filtered locally to completed run_attempt=1 records within the recorded UTC window
filters: created_at within the recorded UTC window

ci_workflow_elapsed_seconds.method: updated_at - created_at; median is the middle value for odd n and the arithmetic mean of the middle pair for even n; p95 uses nearest-rank

limitations: Workflow elapsed time is a proxy, not developer waiting time or engineering productivity.
Failed workflow runs are included in elapsed-time statistics; workflow failure can reflect code, tests, or infrastructure.
The unit is a workflow run, not a distinct pull request; multiple runs from one PR can be counted.
The pass rate is descriptive and does not establish that a specific change caused CI outcomes.
This is one 30-day repository snapshot; compare future windows with identical filters and inspect sample composition before acting.
Branch-protection policy was not rechecked for this snapshot and is not inferred from these workflow runs.
